goal: Create a quiet indoor editorial portrait of one fictional adult with natural body language and restrained visual treatment.
audience: Editorial art directors seeking believable, non-glamour people imagery

content.subject: One fictional adult woman seated naturally against a warm gray plaster wall in a minimal interior
must_include: Modest layered knit and overshirt wardrobe
Quiet seated pose with off-camera gaze
Useful wall and floor negative space

art_direction.style: Photorealistic quiet editorial portrait with subtle film grain and natural light
art_direction.lighting: Soft window side light with broad low-contrast room fill and gentle wall shadows

composition.layout: 9:16 minimal interior portrait with a seated subject low and slightly right of center and generous negative space above
focal_hierarchy: Quiet wall and floor negative space

objective_checks: No text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Hands, knees, socks, and clothing are complete and plausible
The wardrobe and pose are modest and non-sexualized
Skin, hair, textile, wall, and floor read as natural photography
The subject is visually distinct from any reference example
